capabilities: Organize novels and chapters into series with drag ordering, auto-numbering and placement
Write through a whole book in continuous manuscript mode that saves to individual chapter files
Track word counts, plot threads, tags and chapter overviews with synopses and covers
Manage codex lore notes and Story Context dossiers of who and what each chapter mentions
Back up the vault to zip files on a set schedule, with archiving instead of deletion
extras: Author describes it as a pre-release and 'vibe coded'; titleForge (a title/series-name generator) ships as a built-in subplugin documented separately, and the author mentions a Forge Family of companion plugins.
motivation: The author was frustrated with storytelling apps that were either pretty but useless or functional but ugly, and with web apps that required a browser, so built this to turn Obsidian into a storytelling app.
problem: Obsidian has no structured novel-writing features like series ordering, chapter management or lore tracking, and dedicated writing web apps force work into a browser.

relations.evidence: The optional formatForge plugin adds manuscript fonts, colours and dividers, and hosts the shared formatting UI

summary: Novel-writing workspace that organizes novels and chapters into series, keeps a lore codex, offers continuous manuscript editing, word-count history and scheduled backups.
